businessRequirements.title: Table 034 is received only when the request carried Table 049 Sub Table 18 Purchase Restriction Method 2 or 3.

Table 049 Sub Table ID 18 an1: 0 Neither Chip nor Host Based; 1 Chip-Based Only; 2 Host-Based Only; 3 Both Chip and Host Based.

businessRequirements.title: Table 034 applies only to Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 and MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV; Visa applicability stays REVIEW_REQUIRED under SEG111-SME-003.

Table 049 Sub Table ID 18 an1: 0 Neither Chip nor Host Based; 1 Chip-Based Only; 2 Host-Based Only; 3 Both Chip and Host Based.

businessRequirements.title: ATL105 does not name a PSPC version. Without a bound version a code is judged against every supplied version (3.7 and 4.1); if their verdicts differ the result is REVIEW_REQUIRED. A stated version is judged against that version only.
